get_tokenizer_factory: use get_tokenizer to get a SentencePiece or Tiktoken tokenizer based on model name
encode_text_with_tokenizer: encode text into token IDs using the tokenizer encode method
decode_tokens_to_text: decode token IDs back into text using the tokenizer decode method
get_bos_eos_ids: get the beginning and end of sequence token IDs using bos_id and eos_id methods
create_tiktoken_wrapper: create a TiktokenWrapper instance to tokenize text for Llama-3 models
